author: James Joyce
title: Dubliners
edition: New York: B. W. Huebsch, second printing, April 1917 (US first printing December 1916); scan-backed Wikisource transcription of 1917 Dubliners by James Joyce.djvu. HTML emphasis becomes plain text; page-number markers and zero-width page-boundary characters removed, prose line wrapping folded to spaces; original paragraph and embedded verse boundaries retained. The printed row of spaced full stops marking the section break in Eveline (p. 47) is reproduced as its own line of nine spaced periods. The library text holds all fifteen stories in the book's order, each under its printed title; the title page and contents are omitted. On 2026-11-18 Counterparts after its section break, A Mother and Grace were collated word by word against the OCR of Internet Archive dubliners00joycuoft (the scan the Wikisource file was made from) and, to catch misreadings the transcription shares with that OCR, against Project Gutenberg’s Dubliners (ebook 2814), every difference decided on the item’s page images: three readings were corrected (A Mother “Mansion House. He”, Grace “constable, Jack,” and “Mr. Kernan” for “Keman”), and the section breaks in Counterparts (p. 113) and Grace (pp. 197, 219), which the transcription gives as six asterisks, are written as the printed rows of eight spaced full stops. The transcription joins some printed paragraphs: in these stories the print begins a new paragraph inside blocks 835, 840 and 861 (A Mother) and 926, 951, 970, 980, 1019, 1053, 1138 and 1177 (Grace), and block 972 continues the printed paragraph of block 971; mending them changes the numbering of the later blocks, which school nights read, so they are left for a renumbering. For the same reason the library still lacks most of p. 169: the first eight stanzas and two lines of Hynes’s poem in Ivy Day in the Committee Room, whose text here begins at “Or high ambition spurs him now”.

rights.basis: The English text in this 1917 edition was published before 1931; its US publication copyright term has expired as of 2026. The linked primary transcription/catalogue identifies its US public-domain status. No later editorial introduction is included.

acquisition.method: Wikisource MediaWiki parse API (action=parse, prop=text), one request per story subpage in printed order: The Sisters, An Encounter, Araby, Eveline, After the Race, Two Gallants, The Boarding House, A Little Cloud, Counterparts, Clay, A Painful Case, Ivy Day in the Committee Room, A Mother, Grace, The Dead (main-namespace revisions 14966105, 5179127, 6617246, 5179133, 5179150, 5179157, 5917680, 10774318, 5930415, 10774329, 9933978, 5930417, 10774324, 6587783, 14966104). downloadSha256 is the SHA-256 of the fifteen JSON responses concatenated in that order; downloadUrl is the first of them. Only the transcluded scan text (div.prp-pages-output) is used: Wikisource headers, notes, audio links, page-number anchors and zero-width page-boundary characters removed; HTML emphasis dropped to plain text; whitespace collapsed to single spaces; HTML line breaks kept as stanza lines, blank lines between verse lines splitting stanzas; each story's centred title became a heading; the Eveline section-break row of dots is written as nine spaced full stops, as the edition note states. On 2026-11-18 blocks 502, 973 and 1201 (six asterisks) became the printed row of eight spaced full stops and blocks 872, 1014 and 1137 were corrected, each on the page images of IA dubliners00joycuoft; paragraph boundaries in those passages were compared with the line indents in that item’s hOCR. The other asterisk lines (blocks 322, 436, 1311, 1483) await the same check.
